
### Zero frequency

```{r}
plot_obs_pred(zero_frequency, x = ~age, xlab = "Age", ylab = "Frequency of zero",
  color = ~model, colors = cols, add_buttons = FALSE, text = ~paste("Observations:", n),
  hovertemplate = "Age %{x}<br>Frequency %{y:.3f}<br>%{text}<extra>%{fullData.name}</extra>") |>
  plotly::layout(yaxis = list(range = c(0, 1)))
```

Points show observed zero frequencies. Lines show fitted probabilities averaged over the same years. The comparison uses sampled observations from the Poisson-link delta family and excludes structurally unfished ages.
